title: Crispy Italian Sausage and Orecchiette
description: A simple, satisfying pasta dish made with crispy Italian sausage and creamy sauce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orecchiette according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, cook the Italian sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned and crispy.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set it aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, add the sliced yellowed onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the crispy garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the canned crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let it cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked orecchiette to the skillet and toss it with the sauce.
Return the Italian sausage to the skillet and toss it with the pasta and sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, topped with grated parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle with extra olive oil, if desired.
